mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q01.stem: ISO14001 certification automatically makes all emissions and work compliant.
reasons: True is incorrect. Certification does not mean automatic compliance of individual operations or emissions.
False is correct. Certification does not mean automatic compliance of individual operations or emissions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q02.stem: PDCA evaluates results after implementation and feeds them into the next plan.
reasons: True is correct. Separate implementation from effect and reflect evaluation in standards or subsequent plans.
False is inappropriate. Separate implementation from effect and reflect evaluation in standards or subsequent plans.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q03.stem: Investigate previous-process removal when deep scratches remain.
reasons: True is correct. Finishing alone may not remove deep prior-process scratches.
False is inappropriate. Finishing alone may not remove deep prior-process scratches.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q04.stem: Cutting safety or inspection to meet delivery is always good QCDS improvement.
reasons: True is incorrect. QCDS must preserve quality and safety too.
False is correct. QCDS must preserve quality and safety too.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q05.stem: Neutralization forming water from H⁺ and OH⁻ always changes oxidation numbers and is redox.
reasons: True is incorrect. The elements' oxidation numbers do not change in this neutralization.
False is correct. The elements' oxidation numbers do not change in this neutralization.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q06.stem: Hydrogen-ion concentration changes with falling pH are not simple numeric subtraction.
reasons: True is correct. pH is logarithmic; one unit corresponds to roughly tenfold concentration.
False is inappropriate. pH is logarithmic; one unit corresponds to roughly tenfold concentration.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q07.stem: Positive finite resistors in parallel always give resistance greater than the largest resistor.
reasons: True is incorrect. Their parallel resistance is smaller than the smallest resistor.
False is correct. Their parallel resistance is smaller than the smallest resistor.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q08.stem: Dyeing and sealing are post-treatments with different purposes.
reasons: True is correct. Dyeing adds color; sealing closes pores and has related functions.
False is inappropriate. Dyeing adds color; sealing closes pores and has related functions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q09.stem: A rectifier converts AC to DC.
reasons: True is correct. Its main role is converting AC into DC.
False is inappropriate. Its main role is converting AC into DC.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q10.stem: Matching gloss permits unauthorized layer-structure changes.
reasons: True is incorrect. Layer changes affect function and require approval.
False is correct. Layer changes affect function and require approval.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q11.stem: Typical brass mainly contains copper and zinc.
reasons: True is correct. Typical brass is principally Cu and Zn.
False is inappropriate. Typical brass is principally Cu and Zn.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q12.stem: Repeated use of approved boxes is reuse.
reasons: True is correct. Using an item repeatedly is reuse.
False is inappropriate. Using an item repeatedly is reuse.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q13.stem: A molten bath is hot, so water on wet items is irrelevant.
reasons: True is incorrect. High temperature makes rapid water vaporization hazardous.
False is correct. High temperature makes rapid water vaporization hazardous.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q14.stem: pH-meter calibration is a check when investigating out-of-range values.
reasons: True is correct. Separate calibration problems from process changes.
False is inappropriate. Separate calibration problems from process changes.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q15.stem: Do not independently discard unknown containers in the name of tidying.
reasons: True is correct. Chemical disposal follows specified identification and decisions.
False is inappropriate. Chemical disposal follows specified identification and decisions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q16.stem: An alloy name reveals every exact addition ratio in the actual item.
reasons: True is incorrect. Actual alloys can have other additions or formulation differences.
False is correct. Actual alloys can have other additions or formulation differences.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q17.stem: Tiny holes are always irrelevant to corrosion protection.
reasons: True is incorrect. Water or oxygen can act through small holes.
False is correct. Water or oxygen can act through small holes.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q18.stem: Surface oxide can affect apparent corrosion.
reasons: True is correct. A protective film can suppress reaction.
False is inappropriate. A protective film can suppress reaction.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q19.stem: Operators classify oxides by putting unknown material into acid.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not test classifications by adding unknown substances to chemicals.
False is correct. Do not test classifications by adding unknown substances to chemicals.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q20.stem: Convert between N and mol/L after checking reaction conditions.
reasons: True is correct. N alone can leave the reaction factor unspecified.
False is inappropriate. N alone can leave the reaction factor unspecified.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q21.stem: Sufficient tank capacity removes the need to check its material.
reasons: True is incorrect. Capacity and chemical/thermal compatibility are different.
False is correct. Capacity and chemical/thermal compatibility are different.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q22.stem: Activation is always better in stronger liquid for longer time.
reasons: True is incorrect. Insufficient and excessive treatment can both cause problems; follow specified conditions.
False is correct. Insufficient and excessive treatment can both cause problems; follow specified conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q23.stem: Records under the same conditions make improvement effects easier to compare.
reasons: True is correct. Different conditions obscure changes attributable to measures.
False is inappropriate. Different conditions obscure changes attributable to measures.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q24.stem: An operator may return items to acid without recording a process reversal.
reasons: True is incorrect. Unauthorized reversal can cause overtreatment or unclear history.
False is correct. Unauthorized reversal can cause overtreatment or unclear history.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q25.stem: Electroless plating still needs concentration, temperature and pH control.
reasons: True is correct. Chemical deposition also depends on controlled liquid conditions.
False is inappropriate. Chemical deposition also depends on controlled liquid conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q26.stem: A weak electrolyte always means merely a dilute liquid.
reasons: True is incorrect. Weak refers to partial dissociation, not dilution.
False is correct. Weak refers to partial dissociation, not dilution.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q27.stem: Opening a running filter is a safe way to investigate.
reasons: True is incorrect. Pressure and residual chemicals create hazards during operation.
False is correct. Pressure and residual chemicals create hazards during operation.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q28.stem: Neutral-oxide classification does not mean harmless to people.
reasons: True is correct. CO is an example of a harmful neutral oxide.
False is inappropriate. CO is an example of a harmful neutral oxide.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q29.stem: Colorimeter readings eliminate checks of location and optical conditions.
reasons: True is incorrect. Instrumental color measurement also specifies position and optical conditions.
False is correct. Instrumental color measurement also specifies position and optical conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-09-theory-q30.stem: Record blisters and discoloration as separate observed conditions.
reasons: True is correct. Separating conditions improves comparison and cause investigation.
False is inappropriate. Separating conditions improves comparison and cause investigation.
